description: The app’s Fog cases, newest first: when the Fogs running a room’s server file computed different states, Neblla compared them, the majority won, and the odd one’s user was flagged. Each case: room, seq, status (flagged | undecided | reassigned | annulled), fogs (userId, appUserId, leader, verdict: majority | odd | missing | undecided), diff (only the paths that differ), flagged. Undecided: no majority (two Fogs, or three different states) — nobody was flagged.
name: neblla_list_fog_cases
title: List fog cases
